quest.title: Ascension Challenge IV
quest.description: The Genius Invokation TCG Society has determined that you are qualified for the Ascension Challenge. Win the Challenge and become a Legend player! We hope you will have fun with Genius Invokation TCG!
quest.rewards_formatted: Lucky Coin x1500, Legend Player Badge x1

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here for the Ascension Challenge!

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow... (Hmm? Here for the Ascension Challenge? I see... You are indeed qualified for the challenge. Alright...)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: "I'll have Shuyun set up the challenge for you immediately. Do be careful!"

talks.objective: Finish Ascension Challenge duel with Prince

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow! (How wonderful! Congratulations on completing the Ascension Challenge. You're now a Legend player!)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow... (A Legend player, what an admirable title...)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: (I hope you'll keep honing your technique and become a great player who lives up to this grand title!)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: (It might be a bit redundant to say this at this point, but still...)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: #({NICKNAME}, may the fun be with you in the world of Genius Invokation TCG!)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow... (How unfortunate... Try to be extra careful next time and perhaps make some adjustments to your deck before your next attempt.)

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: (I believe you are capable of completing this challenge.)
